games.seat_order_confidence: high; turn-passing sequence in captions is fully consistent and matches the overlay turn counter at three sampled points
games.win_turn_notes: Winner's own turns elapsed = 6: table rounds 1-5 plus a Seedtime extra turn on which the kill executes. The broadcast overlay still reads TURN 05 at the KO because the extra turn does not increment the table round.
games.win_method: Deterministic mill-out loop: Grinding Station (tap, sacrifice an artifact: mill 3; untaps whenever an artifact enters) + Nuka-Cola Vending Machine (whenever you sacrifice a Food, create a tapped Treasure) + Academy Manufactor (every token event becomes Food + Clue + Treasure). Zeb mills all three opponents' libraries out three cards at a time, then taps Geier Reach Sanitarium so every player draws; the three empty-library opponents lose to the draw. Set up through a Seedtime extra turn and Shifting Woodland (delirium) copying Kuldotha Forgemaster from his own graveyard to fetch the Vending Machine.

KO.

games.creator_mvc_overlay: Editor's 'most valuable card' at 20:39: Academy Manufactor; 'getting three tokens every time someone cast a non-creature spell' is what let Zeb leverage his advantage and close out the game
games.extraction_confidence: high for winner, win turn, and win method (frame-verified KO and overlays); high for seat order; medium for individual plays; low for the specific cards in a few mill batches

headline_features.win_method_class: mill-out combo loop (no combat kill, no life-total kill); winner at 36 life, all opponents above 27 at the KO
extra_turns: Seedtime (round 5), enabled by the opponent's own blue counterspells cast that turn; the kill executes on the extra turn
notable_lines: Reality Scramble self-Polymorph puts Niv-Mizzet, Parun into play on turn 3 through a Swords attempt and a Force of Will fight
Grinding Station mill used as targeted interaction: destroying a Proteus-Staff-stacked library in response to Gamble
Shifting Woodland as a graveyard toolbox: copies Allosaurus Shepherd for uncounterability, then Kuldotha Forgemaster to fetch the final combo piece
Silence resolves against the winning turn and does nothing because the kill is entirely activated abilities
Godo player never casts his commander all game
headline_features.sim_relevance: This is exactly the kind of politics-and-stack-heavy engine win the calibration doc says Forge undersells: the win required a negotiated Academy Manufactor resolution (round 3 table talk), bait spells to enable Seedtime, and response-window mill timing

open_questions: When Jaheira, Friend of the Forest entered play: referenced as in play from round 4 ('The Shire enters untapped cuz I have a legendary Jaheira') and tapped for mana thereafter, but its cast never appears in captions.

Nature's Rhythm is listed among the round-5 self-milled cards yet is cast from hand on the extra turn; either that mill batch is misheard, a recursion effect (Noxious Revival is in the list) was cut, or the cast card was misidentified.
The exact rules text of The Cabbage Merchant (TLA crossover commander): its Food-creation trigger cadence is inferred from behavior only.
Three milled Malcolm/Kediss cards remain unidentified: 'Stone to Deadly', 'myr retriever', 'mystery impulse'.
The 'Snow-Covered Island' in Zeb's revealed hand (round 3) contradicts the mono-green list; likely 'Snow-Covered Forest' misheard, but the published list runs plain Forests.

Whether 'counter mission' in the Gifts Ungiven reveal is Commandeer or caption noise, and which two Gifts piles went to graveyard vs hand (only Fierce Guardianship's arrival in hand is certain).
